function.name: resolve_terms
function.description: Building concepts and sensor classes that lay words map to.

function.name: find_spaces
function.description: Rooms, zones and floors whose name or id contains the text, with the facts the building model records about each (type, floor, capacity and other properties).

function.name: find_points
function.description: Sensor points measuring a quantity in a place, with timeseries ids (uuid) and stores (stored_at); lists the other points in the place when none match.

function.name: get_readings
function.description: Readings between start and end (building LOCAL time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM): per point n, first/last time, min/mean/max, largest gap, and how many of the points asked had data.

function.name: query_records
function.description: Rows of a building register (bookings, maintenance, schedules, inspections, ...), optionally filtered by text; with no match, the list of registers the building holds.

function.name: search_documents
function.description: Passages from the building's uploaded documents, with document names.

function.name: find_amenities_or_topics
function.description: Facilities and knowledge topics the building describes.
